subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should an omitted agent `facing` value remain an explicit cross-node front-camera contract, or be preserved so iOS can apply the user's Talk camera preference while other nodes retain their own defaults?
rationale: This is a user-visible node-command default change, not only a local UI addition; the intended compatibility contract needs an owner decision before a mechanical repair can be selected.

options.title: Preserve omission for node-local defaults
options.body: Stop serializing a synthetic front value when the agent omitted `facing`, document the iOS preference behavior, and retain explicit agent values as authoritative.

options.title: Keep the explicit front contract
options.body: Retain the existing agent-tool default and narrow the camera-flip control so it does not imply that agent captures use the preference.

recommendation.title: Preserve omission for node-local defaults
recommendation.body: Stop serializing a synthetic front value when the agent omitted `facing`, document the iOS preference behavior, and retain explicit agent values as authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current iOS camera and Talk integration proposal and is the closest available routing candidate in the supplied history.
